"Score the card 1-5 on each criterion. For each score give ref, the card line (card:<field>) that decides it, or plan:<field path> when no card line carries it, and a reason of at most 25 words. Use NA only where a criterion allows it. Then name decides_by: the id of the earliest phase after which decision_rule can be applied whichever outcome occurs, or \"none\". A phase that only reproduces a published number, or only measures throughput the question does not ask about, does not count. Give decides_by_reason in at most 25 words. Decide only from the text below; do not use tools.
Root question: Can molecular mapping of AAV capsid-receptor interactions on brain microvascular endothelial cells determine which AAV variants transcytose across the blood-brain barrier versus remain intracellular, and for which capsid-receptor binding signatures?
Option record: {\"id\":\"Option 1: Exhaustive capsid–receptor complex enumeration (docking and AlphaFold-Multimer)\",\"title\":\"Exhaustive capsid–receptor complex enumeration (docking and AlphaFold-Multimer)\",\"summary\":\"Enumerate binding modes of engineered capsid libraries against the BBB receptor panel (LY6A, LY6C1, ALPL, LRP6, CA4, AAVR) with docking, MD refinement, and AlphaFold-Multimer to test whether transcytosis-competent pairs share a geometric motif such as 3-fold-axis engagement of GPI-anchored receptors (https://www.voyagertherapeutics.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/POSTER-Voyager_ASGCT_2024_FINAL_Ishan.pdf). Published modeling covers only single-digit complexes, e.g. AlphaFold-Multimer models of LRP6 with AAV-X1 and CAP-Mac VR-VIII peptides (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11381518), against an experimental catalog of ~150 AAV capsid structures (https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12682079). Narrowing: This leaves aside everything after binding — endosomal sorting, lysosomal degradation, nuclear import — so the computed interface geometry stands in for the binding step alone, not for fate. Its answer still moves the root question because it either widens or closes the catalog of candidate signatures (Q3) against which the sufficiency claim (Q1) must be tested.\",\"root_link\":\"Bears on Q3 of the root question — for which capsid–receptor binding signatures transcytosis occurs — specifically whether a shared interface motif marks transcytosis-competent complexes.\",\"compute_open\":\"More parallel compute would buy model runs (capsid × receptor × pose); published measurements of its effect stop at single-digit numbers of AAV–receptor complexes modeled per study — two LRP6 peptide complexes in https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11381518 — and above that it is unknown whether exhaustive enumeration would surface a shared transcytosis-competent motif or demonstrate that no such motif exists.\",\"sequential\":\"none: every capsid–receptor pair is an independent docking or AlphaFold-Multimer job with its own random seeds, so the work already splits into independent pieces.\",\"source_urls\":[\"https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11381518\",\"https://www.voyagertherapeutics.com/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/POSTER-Voyager_ASGCT_2024_FINAL_Ishan.pdf\",\"https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12682079\"]}
Card:
card:question: Does exhaustive modeling of AAV capsid–receptor complexes reveal a shared interface motif, like 3-fold-axis GPI-receptor engagement, that marks which capsids transcytose the BBB?
card:hypothesis: Transcytosis-competent capsids engage GPI-anchored BBB receptors at the capsid 3-fold spike with a shared anchor geometry, unlike non-cognate pairs [s_appraise].
card:sequential_part: None: each capsid–receptor pair is an independent docking and folding job; only short refinements chain within one pair.
card:method: none
card:if_lever: At 2,880 models the competent-minus-retained GPI-engagement gap reaches 0.50 or more, while at 144 models it stays below 0.25.
card:if_not: The gap stays within 0.15 of its 144-model value at every depth; added poses change nothing because insert location already fixes the 3-fold site [s_cat].
card:test_summary: Run 72 pairs at 144, 720, 2,880 pose models on 8x A100s [s_lambda], anchored on the published PHP.eB–LY6A complex [s_appraise]; compare with the ten-model published baseline and the 144-model shallow arm against phenotype labels [s_alpl].
card:closest_prior: The earlier APPRAISE-AAV study used AlphaFold-Multimer, ten replicate models per matrix, to rank capsid peptides against the receptors LY6A, LY6C1 and CA4, validating one PHP.eB–LY6A pose [s_appraise].
card:left_open: Whether a shared 3-fold-axis GPI-engagement motif marks transcytosis-competent pairs across a whole capsid panel, or whether deeper pose sampling changes that call [s_appraise].
card:anchor: Rebuild the published PHP.eB peptide–LY6A complex and require its validated contacts and capsid fit before any library spend [s_appraise].
card:limits: Predicted interface geometry only, not transcytosis rates or post-binding fate; weak avidity-dependent contacts may evade prediction [s_appraise]; twelve capsids, six receptors.
